en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
Drinking green tea after a meal
Sleeping after a meal
Exercising after a meal

Drinking tea after a meal is so relaxing!
Makes you feel like you're alive...

Hahaha, okay, maybe that
was a *bit* dramatic...

But...maybe that feeling has something
to do with my hidden talent? I dunno.

Maybe I had a near-death experience or
something, or got death threats...

Maybe that's why I'm so grateful to be
alive at times like this. Something like that.

...Nah, maybe not.
I can't imagine I'd be a violent person...

Well, you do get pretty sleepy
after a big meal!

But I've heard that napping during
the day isn't such a bad thing, y'know?

It helps relieve stress and recharges
your brain. Makes you more efficient!

So, do you want to take a
nap with me, Shuichi?

Listen, I know you're all
about burning calories and whatnot...

But exercising after a meal
gives me a tummyache...

Sorry, Shuichi.
Gonna have to pass on that one.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Rantaro looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Rantaro's inner thoughts...?
